title: Add character creation navigation, review, save, and resume
notes: Review fix pushed to PR #303: unnamed-draft id now character-<timestamp>-<random> (crypto entropy) instead of a per-process counter that collided on character-1 across runs and overwrote saved drafts; generated id surfaced for --resume. Regression tests added.
close_reason: Merged via PR #303. Wizard shell: shared ?/list/search/back/review/set/save/quit over the pure engine; review renders identity/class/ancestry/bg/scores/HP/spell-DC/spells/errors/missing; drafts persist to <dataRoot>/drafts/characters/<id>.json via injectable atomic store; resume rehydrates, quit offers save, EOF autosaves. Unnamed-draft ids use crypto entropy (no cross-run overwrite) and are surfaced for --resume. Resolver listAncestries/listBackgrounds/listSpells added.
